name: Onee-chan Change
source: Ryosuke has an older sister, Yukina, who is always severe with him. Haruaki, Ryosuke's neighbor, also has an older sister, Youko, who is always soft with him. Ryosuke and Haruaki are friends and always complain about their older sisters. One day, their parents go abroad on vacation and they decide to swap their older sisters.... Severe older sister or soft older sister.... Which one would you choose?
translation: Ryosuke有一个总是对他很严厉的姐姐Yukina。邻居Haruaki也有一个姐姐Youko，她总是温柔地对待弟弟。Ryosuke和Haruaki是朋友，经常抱怨自己的姐姐。一天，双方父母出国度假，他们决定交换姐姐…严厉的姐姐，还是温柔的姐姐…你会选择哪一个？
